QPC HAFS QURAN TEXT AND FONT (KFGQPC)
=====================================

What Iman uses (Uthmani script, Quran reader only)
  Text:  "QPC Hafs script - Ayah by Ayah", published by the King Fahd Glorious
         Quran Printing Complex (KFGQPC).
         https://qul.tarteel.ai/resources/quran-script/86
  Font:  "QPC Hafs" / KFGQPC Uthmanic Hafs, file uthmanic_hafs_v2_2.ttf.
         https://qul.tarteel.ai/resources/font/245
  Both were obtained from the Quranic Universal Library (QUL):
  https://qul.tarteel.ai/

Attribution
  Quran text and font: King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex (KFGQPC),
  via the Quranic Universal Library (QUL).

Terms
  KFGQPC publishes its digital Quran resources for free use, including in
  software. See its usage statements:
  https://dm.qurancomplex.gov.sa/rights/
  https://qurancomplex.gov.sa/privacypolicy/

  The font's embedded copyright notice reads:
  "The digitally signed machine readable Typeface(Font) licensed to you is
  copyrighted, (2010), King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex.
  ISBN: 978-603-8010-15-0, Accession No. 1430/7278.
  All rights reserved. This Font is the property of King Fahd Glorious Quran
  Printing Complex, and may not be reproduced, modified without the express
  written approval of King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex."

  The text and font remain the property of KFGQPC and are not covered by
  Iman's GPLv3 license.

How Iman follows this
  - Free of charge, no ads, no paywall.
  - The text and font are not modified.
  - They are used only for Quran text.
  - The font file is not in the repository.
